title: The same project is never quoted a different range later in the chat

turns.user: What is the price range for an e-commerce store?

model.text: An e-commerce store runs from 120000 to 350000 PKR depending on the scope.

turns.user: Same project, but I also want a loyalty programme inside it. Give me the range again.
turns.expect: the same range, or the owner — never a second, different one

model.text: With the loyalty programme it would be 120000 – 180000 PKR.
It is still the same range I gave you: 120000 to 350000 PKR, and the loyalty programme fits inside it. Shall I put the details in a quote?

forbid: the loyalty programme it would be

require.why: the first range is repeated, not replaced
